name: heat-green-vote-berlin-2026
title: Heat, green and the vote: Berlin 2026, derived district tables
description: Committed outputs of the pipeline in this repository: urban indicators and party-list results per polling-station district of the Berlin Abgeordnetenhaus election of 20 September 2026 (preliminary results), the Earth Engine zonal statistics they are built from, and the correlation results of the pre-registered analysis plan. Districts are keyed by uwb, the Urnenwahlbezirk number of the official 2026 geometries. Ecological data: values describe districts, not voters. docs/data_dictionary.md is rendered from this file by src/data_dictionary.py.

resources.name: indicators
resources.description: The analysis table: one row per polling-station district (analysis.indicators in PostGIS, sql/50_indicators.sql, without geometry). Vote outcomes use postal allocation method C. Indicators are computed over the district's residential land.

fields.name: uwb
fields.description: Polling-station district (Urnenwahlbezirk) number; the first two digits are the Bezirk.

fields.name: bez
fields.description: Bezirk (borough) number, 01 to 12.

fields.name: residents
fields.description: Residents 2025 in the district, from population blocks split by area where a block crosses a district boundary.

fields.name: residential_residents
fields.description: Residents of blocks that count as residential land (excluding open land and infrastructure block types).

fields.name: density_residential
fields.description: residential_residents per hectare of residential land. Empty where the district has no residential land.

fields.name: log_density_residential
fields.description: Natural logarithm of density_residential; the control variable of the Tier 1 partial correlations.

fields.name: lst
fields.description: Summer land surface temperature: area-weighted mean over the zone in satellite_zone of the per-pixel median of clear Landsat 8/9 observations, June to August 2023 to 2025.

fields.name: ndvi
fields.description: Summer NDVI: area-weighted mean over the zone in satellite_zone of the per-pixel median of clear Sentinel-2 observations, June to August 2023 to 2025.
fields.source: Sentinel-2 SR, Cloud Score+; src/gee_extract.py, sql/35_satellite.sql

fields.name: satellite_zone
fields.description: Area over which lst and ndvi were averaged: the residential land, or the whole district when residential land is missing or too small (imagery.min_residential_pixels).

fields.name: satellite_fallback
fields.description: True where satellite_zone is the whole district.

fields.name: access_index
fields.description: Mean over the 7 amenity categories of the z-scored ln(1 + mean nearest distance in m). 0 is the Berlin district average; higher means farther from everyday services.

fields.name: population_mismatch
fields.description: True where the 2026 register lists more eligible voters than the 2025 population has residents, or the district has no residential land; population-weighted indicators are unreliable there.

fields.name: dist_health
fields.description: Residents-weighted mean straight-line distance from residential land to the nearest doctor, clinic, hospital or pharmacy.

fields.name: dist_kindergartens
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest kindergarten.

fields.name: dist_parks
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest park (distance to its edge).

fields.name: dist_playgrounds
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest public playground.

fields.name: dist_public_transport_stops
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest bus stop, tram stop or rail station.

fields.name: dist_schools
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest school.

fields.name: dist_supermarkets
fields.description: As dist_health, to the nearest supermarket.

fields.name: afd
fields.description: AfD (P05) share of valid Zweitstimmen, station plus allocated postal votes (method C).

fields.name: bsw
fields.description: BSW (P24) share of valid Zweitstimmen, method C.

fields.name: cdu
fields.description: CDU (P01) share of valid Zweitstimmen, method C.

fields.name: contrast
fields.description: Left-right contrast: (Linke + Grüne) minus (CDU + AfD) share, method C. Describes two ideological camps, not a coalition.

fields.name: contrast_with_spd
fields.description: As contrast, with the SPD added to the left camp (Tier 2 variant).

fields.name: gruene
fields.description: Bündnis 90/Die Grünen (P03) share of valid Zweitstimmen, method C.

fields.name: linke
fields.description: Die Linke (P04) share of valid Zweitstimmen, method C.

fields.name: spd
fields.description: SPD (P02) share of valid Zweitstimmen, method C.

fields.name: turnout
fields.description: Voters (station plus allocated postal) divided by eligible voters, method C.

resources.name: ee-zonal
resources.description: Earth Engine zonal statistics per district, zone and indicator (raw.ee_zonal). Lets the pipeline run without Earth Engine credentials (make gee-from-csv).

fields.name: uwb
fields.description: Polling-station district number.

fields.name: zone
fields.description: Residential land of the district, or the whole district.

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: Summer land surface temperature (degrees C) or NDVI.

fields.name: mean
fields.description: Area-weighted mean of the composite over the zone.

fields.name: median
fields.description: Area-weighted median of the composite over the zone.

fields.name: n_eff_pixels
fields.unit: pixels (30 m for lst, 10 m for ndvi)
fields.description: Effective pixels: the zone's area with valid data divided by the pixel area.

fields.name: mean_obs
fields.description: Mean number of clear observations per pixel in the composite over the zone.

resources.name: ee-meta
resources.description: Run metadata of the Earth Engine extraction: run time, earthengine-api version, extent, season, collections and parameters, scene counts per year and clear-observation percentiles. Rendered in docs/provenance.md.

resources.name: tier1
resources.description: Tier 1 (confirmatory) correlations: partial Spearman rho controlling for log residential density, method C, Holm correction over the 16 tests.

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: Indicator column of the indicators table.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome column of the indicators table.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Districts with complete data for the pair and the control.

fields.name: rho
fields.description: Partial Spearman rho.

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower 95 % confidence limit (Fisher transform, Bonett-Wright standard error); assumes independent districts.

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper 95 % confidence limit.

fields.name: p
fields.description: Two-sided p-value, unadjusted; assumes independent districts, which spatial autocorrelation violates.

fields.name: p_holm
fields.description: Holm-adjusted p-value over the Tier 1 tests.

fields.name: significant
fields.description: p_holm below analysis.alpha (0.05).

resources.name: tier2
resources.description: Tier 2 robustness: every Tier 1 pair under each variant (allocation methods A, B, S; without population_mismatch districts; raw correlation; contrast with SPD).

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: Indicator column of the indicators table.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Outcome column of the indicators table.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Robustness variant.

fields.name: tier1_rho
fields.description: The pair's Tier 1 rho, for comparison.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Districts with complete data in this variant.

fields.name: rho
fields.description: Spearman rho in this variant (partial on log density, except the raw variant).

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower 95 % confidence limit.

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper 95 % confidence limit.

fields.name: p
fields.description: Two-sided p-value, unadjusted.

fields.name: same_sign
fields.description: rho has the same sign as tier1_rho.

fields.name: rho_change
fields.description: Absolute difference between rho and tier1_rho.

resources.name: tier3
resources.description: Tier 3 (exploratory) raw Spearman rho between 10 indicators (rows) and 7 outcomes (columns), method C, no p-values.

fields.name: indicator
fields.description: Indicator (residential_density refers to density_residential).

fields.name: linke
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the Die Linke share.

fields.name: cdu
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the CDU share.

fields.name: afd
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the AfD share.

fields.name: gruene
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the Grüne share.

fields.name: spd
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the SPD share.

fields.name: bsw
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with the BSW share.

fields.name: turnout
fields.description: Raw Spearman rho with turnout.

resources.name: moran
resources.description: Global Moran's I per variable: queen contiguity, row-standardised, 999 permutations, fixed seed.

fields.name: variable
fields.description: Variable of the indicators table.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Districts with data.

fields.name: moran_i
fields.description: Global Moran's I.

fields.name: expected_i
fields.description: Expected I without spatial autocorrelation, -1 / (n - 1).

fields.name: p_sim
fields.description: Pseudo p-value from the permutations.

fields.name: islands
